projects.brief: A fully designed and executed villa, where modern elegance meets refined details.
statement: This villa in Borg El Arab was designed and executed with a focus on creating a refined, cohesive living experience. Every space was carefully planned to balance functionality, comfort, and visual elegance.

The reception brings together warm tones, elegant furniture, and carefully designed lighting. The bedrooms offer a calm and comfortable atmosphere, while the kitchen and bathrooms combine practical layouts with carefully selected finishes.
From the overall composition to the smallest details, the project reflects Iconic's approach to delivering thoughtful design through precise execution.
projects.title: Borg El Arab Villa

projects.brief: A contemporary apartment designed with a refined balance of elegance, comfort, and functionality.
statement: Suez Flat is a contemporary residential project that brings together elegant interiors, rich materials, and carefully designed spaces.

The reception and dining areas feature a refined combination of textures, warm finishes, and distinctive lighting. The bedrooms offer individual design identities, balancing comfort, functionality, and visual character.
Every space was thoughtfully designed to create a cohesive home, reflecting Iconic's attention to detail and commitment to quality.
projects.title: Suez Flat

projects.brief: A thoughtfully designed apartment combining modern elegance, functional spaces, and refined interior details.
statement: This apartment in El Ekbal, Alexandria, was designed and executed to create a cohesive and functional living environment with a refined modern character.
The project includes a welcoming reception and living area, a carefully designed kitchen, a comfortable master bedroom, and two thoughtfully designed bathrooms, including a guest bathroom.
Every space was planned with attention to layout, material selection, lighting, and detailing to ensure a seamless balance between aesthetics and everyday functionality.
From the main living areas to the smallest finishing details, the project reflects Iconic's commitment to thoughtful design and precise execution.
projects.title: El Ekbal Flat

projects.brief: A fully designed and executed apartment in Alexandria, combining elegant interiors with functional details.
statement: This apartment in El Ekbal, Alexandria, was designed and executed with a focus on creating a cohesive and comfortable living experience.

The living area features a refined combination of warm tones, elegant furniture, and carefully selected lighting. The kitchen balances functionality with a clean, modern aesthetic, while the bedrooms and bathrooms reflect attention to detail and thoughtful material selection.
From the overall design to the finishing touches, every space was carefully executed to deliver a complete and harmonious home.
projects.title: Sawary Flat

projects.brief: A modern boys’ bedroom designed with smart functionality, bold details, and a refined contemporary style.
materials: Wooden wall panels and custom joinery
statement: This boys’ bedroom in Antoniades, Alexandria, was designed to create a modern and functional space that balances comfort with contemporary style.

The design combines a dedicated study area with practical storage solutions and a thoughtfully arranged sleeping zone. Dark accents, warm wood finishes, and carefully integrated lighting create a cohesive and comfortable atmosphere.
Every detail was considered to make the room both practical and visually distinctive.
projects.title: Antoniades Boys’ Bedroom

projects.brief: A contemporary apartment design combining warm tones, elegant details, and refined modern living.
materials: Natural wood finishes and wall panels
statement: This apartment in Mountain View, Cairo, was designed to create a sophisticated and welcoming living environment through a harmonious blend of contemporary design and warm natural tones.

The living and dining areas feature elegant furniture, refined textures, and carefully designed lighting. The kitchen combines clean aesthetics with practical functionality, while the master bedroom and dressing area offer a calm and luxurious atmosphere.
Distinctive architectural details, elegant arches, warm wood finishes, and thoughtfully selected materials bring character and continuity to every space.
Every detail reflects Iconic's commitment to creating functional, elegant, and cohesive interiors.
projects.title: Mountain View Flat

projects.brief: A refined mosque interior where architectural elegance meets spiritual serenity.
statement: The Interior Sawary Mosque project reflects a thoughtful approach to architectural design, bringing together elegance, harmony, and a sense of tranquility.

Every detail contributes to creating a welcoming spiritual environment, where carefully considered proportions, refined finishes, and architectural elements work together to enhance the overall experience.
A design that celebrates the beauty of Islamic architecture through simplicity, balance, and timeless details.
projects.title: Interior Sawary Mosque

spreads.body: A timber-panelled family room rendered twice — once by daylight and once after dark — and a terrazzo guest bath that carries the same warmth.
spreads.title: Modern Boho Residence

media.alt: A family living room with a timber-panelled television wall, a bouclé armchair and a low round coffee table under a lit cove

mediaB.alt: An arched mirror framed in terrazzo and backlit against a sage wall
mediaB.caption: Guest bath — the mirror

spreads.body: Smoked oak, black marble and bronze, lit from inside the joinery so the ceilings stay empty and the house is calm at night.
spreads.title: Villa Obsidian

media.alt: A dark sofa in front of a backlit wall of vertical timber slats

mediaB.alt: A black kitchen with a Nero Marquina island lit from beneath its cabinets
mediaB.caption: Kitchen

spreads.body: Offices that feel closer to a members' club: a stone reception, timber lounges, and glass instead of partitions so daylight reaches the middle of the plan.
spreads.title: Atelier Headquarters

media.alt: An executive office with a sculptural desk and two curved lounge chairs

mediaB.alt: A stone reception desk set against a wall of timber slats
mediaB.caption: Reception

spreads.body: No general light in the dining room at all — every table has its own pool, the bar glows from beneath and the walls are washed from the floor.
spreads.title: Maison Noir

media.alt: A dark lounge bar with a timber-clad counter and a round bronze mirror

mediaB.alt: Clusters of copper pendant lights over deep red booths
mediaB.caption: Dining room

spreads.body: One sweeping curve of walnut draws guests past still water to the desk, and the ceiling drops over the lounge so the hall becomes a room.
spreads.title: The Grand Reception

media.alt: A hotel lobby wrapped in curved timber, with a water feature and stone floor

mediaB.alt: A double-height lobby with a pool, marble floor and a round chandelier
mediaB.caption: Atrium

spreads.body: Daylight and plaster for the clinic, timber and water for the spa below — and every finish chosen to be both calm and easy to keep clean.
spreads.title: Serenity Clinic & Spa

media.alt: An indoor spa pool lined in timber with loungers and warm linear light

mediaB.alt: A bright clinic reception with a white counter and an indoor olive tree
mediaB.caption: Clinic reception

spreads.body: One glass basin, one backlit mirror and a porcelain pendant like a flower. After dark, those two lights are the whole room.
spreads.title: Warm Minimal Guest Bath

media.alt: A ribbed glass basin beneath a backlit arched mirror, with porcelain petal pendants

mediaB.alt: The guest bathroom: stone feature wall, backlit arched mirror and a floating vanity
mediaB.caption: The whole room

testimonials.author: Ahmed Ayman
testimonials.quote: Thanks so much for all of your efforts, guidance & help in making our HOME from A to Z, you've a keen eye for detail, you've turned bricks into a truly wonderful home from the planning phase to the design and execution phase of the project.

testimonials.author: Randa Farouk
testimonials.quote: Very talented and professional! Even in my absence I was out of the country. We discussed all details online and the end result was beyond expectations. Highly recommended.

testimonials.author: Moustafa Shaaban
testimonials.quote: من افضل الشركات اللي تعاملت معاها. شغل ممتاز وتسليم في الميعاد. ربنا يبارك فيك مهندس احمد فوزي
testimonials.translation: One of the best firms I have dealt with. Excellent work, handed over on time. God bless you, Eng. Ahmed Fawzy.

testimonials.author: Dina Elshaikh
testimonials.quote: شكرا يا بشمهندس على زوقك الراقى وطولة بالك وصبرك مع اى حد عشان توصل لاحسن نتيجة. ربنا يوفقك ويرزقك الخير يارب
testimonials.translation: Thank you for your refined taste, your patience, and for bearing with anyone so the result comes out the best it can. May God grant you success and provide you with good.

testimonials.author: Mahmoud Ahmed
testimonials.quote: ماشاء الله يا هندسة فعلا والله مجهود كبير جدا وتصميم وتنفيذ علي أعلي مستوي من الإبداع. ربنا يوفقك دايما ومن نجاح لنجاح
testimonials.translation: Genuinely a very great effort — design and execution at the highest level of creativity. May God always grant you success, from one success to the next.
